__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks freshly hatched and sprightly.  His young fangs are just
growing in as of late.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The young spider is ballooning by you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Old, scaly, but still with a lot of bite in him left.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Yevaud the Usurper of Midgaard is here, grinning evilly at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon yevaud

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Wolf Spider is hairy, very hairy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Wolf Spider is here, licking its bloody fangs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider wolf

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You notice an evil look in his eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The orc is stuck in the web and he can't get out.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle orc

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You notice a glazed look in her eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
The Queen Wasp is here, thinking that you would make a tasty offering
to her master.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wasp queen

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The drone spider walks around doing her master's bidding.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider drone

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The ethereal spider strides here, traveling to different worlds.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider ethereal

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The slave does not mind you, but will fight like a warrior if attacked.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle slave human

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Demoniac in nature, but more mischievous.  He twiddles his thumbs
and creates a magical treasure!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The quasit blinks in and out, grinning at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle quasit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The Bird Spider has very powerful jaws.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Bird Spider snaps its powerful jaws.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider bird

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A dishevelled veteran warrior in disguise is what he is, but he
means well.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Hermit sits here and warns, "Go back before it's too late!"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hermit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He delves deeper into you as you stare at him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Donjonkeeper eyes you and wonders how pure your soul is.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle donjonkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like a lazy bum who sleeps half the time.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The guardian is obviously not doing his job.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle guardian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is a very attractive spider with an ornate gown.  She tempts you
into being one of her many slaves.  She does not possess the venomous
fangs of normal spiders, but then, as you realize, she does not need
them.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Arachnos the Empress of Spiders welcomes you with an evil smile.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider empress arachnos

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is the last bastion of good in this realm.  Her mission is to
someday free the slaves of the Empress.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ki-Rin smiles good-naturedly to you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ki-rin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Rather small, you almost feel sad in killing it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wormkin with no teeth plays here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon wormkin young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A medium-sized dragon--seems it hasn't killed anything yet by itself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A wormkin that has grown a bit stares at you inquisitively.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon wormkin medium

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a human crawling on all four.  It
has eight hairy legs that gives it a tremendous speed on almost any surface and
sharp poisonous fangs to paralyze or kill its prey.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A huge, poisonous spider is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spider poisonous

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This disgusting creature is at the size of a small elephant.  It has eight
huge, hairy legs that would give it a tremendous speed on almost any surface
if it wasn't so immensely fat.  Its large, bulbous eyes stare back at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The huge, bulky Queen Spider is here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle queen spider
